question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM film f
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        fa.actor_id
    FROM film_revenue fr
    JOIN film_actor fa ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
),
actor_film_with_share AS (
    SELECT 
        afr.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        afr.film_id,
        afr.title,
        afr.total_revenue as film_total_revenue,
        ROUND(1.0 * afr.total_revenue / fa_cnt.actor_count, 2) as actor_share
    FROM actor_film_revenue afr
    JOIN actor a ON afr.actor_id = a.actor_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) as actor_count
        FROM film_actor
        GROUP BY film_id
    ) fa_cnt ON afr.film_id = fa_cnt.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        film_id,
        title,
        film_total_revenue,
        actor_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY actor_share DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_with_share
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT 
    actor_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    film_id,
    title,
    film_total_revenue,
    actor_share,
    ROUND(AVG(actor_share) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id), 2) as avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3
ORDER BY actor_id, rn;
